Your device data

Favorites, preferences, saved games, feedback and up to 20 recent discovery summaries are saved in this browser. Data does not sync between browsers or devices, and clearing browser storage erases it.

Clear my saved data removes this app’s local and session data and restores the initial Hades, Windows and $20 defaults. Unrelated websites’ data is not affected.

narrative.overview:
The approved Current page composes taste in a cobalt band above an artwork-led, near-black result stream. Acid-lime marks selected favorites, actions and recorded prices; condensed Anton headings contrast with Manrope controls and prose. “Current” identifies the selected design; “Game Discovery” remains the temporary product title.

On 2026-10-18 the owner selected the exact Current page, then authorized completing M3 and subsequently consolidating discovery controls. Both HTML entries load `current-original.tsx` → `GuestApp`. The same world contains real API discovery, save/feedback actions, device-data disclosure and a matching saved library. The owner-authorized follow-up replaces the advanced section with three compact multi-choice selectors and a two-handle price range. Main confirms the controls revision complete locally on 2026-10-19: the one material metadata-failure fix is RESOLVED, with ship at ONE-SCORED-FIX verdict-pass scope. The reviewer reopened all 18 refreshed captures and found no regression attributable to that fix; the earlier full controls review found no material visual/accessibility regression. The baseline four-fix verdict remains separate. Neither verdict is blanket whole-product or publication approval. M0–M3 remain complete; M3 is local/unpublished, hosted M2 is unchanged and M4 is unstarted/unauthorized.
keyCharacteristics: Cobalt header and composer above a near-black result stream.
Lime favorite chips and artwork toggles with a double lime selection outline.
Compact native checkbox disclosures for modes, platform and catalog genre, followed by a dual-native-range price control.
Artwork-led result rows with catalog genres, recorded USD prices and native evidence disclosures.
Flat hairline structure, Anton headings and Manrope controls and prose.

rules.name: The Region and Action Rule
rules.body: Use cobalt for the request region and lime for selection, actions and price emphasis; retain the source's muted quiet actions.

rules.name: The Display Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Keep Anton for headings and Manrope for controls, prose, prices and the wordmark.

rules.name: The Flat Request Rule
rules.body: Preserve region color, hairlines and spacing instead of introducing lifted cards or decorative effects.

dos: Do preserve the owner-selected Current identity, defaults, compact multi-choice/range controls, artwork picker and result genres when extending guest behavior.
Do keep cobalt regions, lime selections, flat hairlines, Anton headings and Manrope controls.
Do retain source artwork provenance, recorded USD wording, original observation dates and truthful device-storage status.
Do preserve native keyboard interactions, visible focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do distinguish locally complete, unpublished M3 from unchanged hosted M2 and keep the baseline four-fix verdict separate from the controls ONE-SCORED-FIX verdict-pass scope.
donts: Don't retain superseded designs as active alternatives or restore deleted UI through documentation.
Don't replace result genres with platforms/play modes or introduce composition changes beyond the owner-authorized controls revision.
Don't describe the current guest application as a frozen preview or imply that saving automatically means Interested.
Don't present recorded or cached prices as live quotes or feedback behavior as evaluated recommendation quality.
Don't treat scoped review approval or local milestone completion as blanket whole-product/UI release approval or deployment authorization.
